provenance: written by hand on 2026-11-12, not by floor_sweep: `run --only flight` was stopped during its resolution step, before it wrote its own timing file (which would hold only flight_s, flight_cases, flight_resolution_s and workers). The start time is the launching shell's `date`; the end time is flight.csv's modification time; the worker-seconds are the sums of flight.csv's `seconds` column by mode; the resolution checks were re-run by `floor_sweep resolution` (timing_resolution_flight.json).
